name: Song of Valhalla
body:
Your music draws you near to the fallen heroes in battle.

Prerequisite(s): Call down the legends class feature.

Benefit(s): Your call down the legends ability functions as if you had used an Ohalia’s horn. The summoned berserkers still come with the listed equipment; if a sleipnir is summoned, it comes with +2 leather barding and horseshoes of crushing blows +2.
